sources.subject: Klantinteractie-Servicesysteem/KISS-frontend
sources.caveat: Authors of the commits of the last 12 months, told apart by address after the repository's .mailmap. Their organisation is the domain of their address, or for a personal, hidden or noreply address the company on their public profile. The owning organisation (icatt.nl) is the most common organisation domain, the domains and names in publiccode.yml and the owner account; one person with two addresses counts twice. Bots are left out.

results.title: Project health (CHAOSS)
results.description: How active and widely carried the project is: the bus factor, the spread over organisations, how change requests and issues are handled, and how often it releases. Informative: shown, not rated.
results.message: 6 of 6 CHAOSS metrics measured. They are shown for information and do not count in any rating.

metrics.name: Contributor Absence Factor
metrics.explanation: The fewest people who together made half of the commits on the default branch in the last 12 months, of the 100 contributors GitHub reports, among 12 human contributors. At 1 the project depends on a single person. Bots are left out; one person with several accounts or addresses counts more than once.

metrics.name: Organizational Diversity
metrics.explanation: Organisations are told apart by the email domain of the latest 300 commits of the last 12 months (264 commits by people, after the .mailmap) and, for a personal or hidden address, by the company on the author's public profile. The largest is icatt.nl (5 authors), with 59% of the 157 commits whose organisation is known; 41% of the commits come from 8 of 17 authors whose organisation stays unknown. Only these counts are kept, no names, addresses or companies; an organisation is named only when several authors share it.

metrics.name: Change Request Closure Ratio
metrics.explanation: 56 change requests were closed (merged or not) and 55 opened in the last 90 days, bots included. Below 1 the open backlog grows; above 1 it shrinks.

metrics.name: Time to First Response
metrics.explanation: The median time to the first comment or review by someone other than the author, over the 15 latest change requests opened by people between 2026-08-21 and 2026-11-12. 7 got a response; 8 had none yet. Bots are left out.

metrics.name: Issue Response Time
metrics.explanation: The median time to the first comment by someone other than the author, over the 15 latest issues opened by people between 2026-08-21 and 2026-11-12. 1 got a response; 14 had none yet. Bots are left out.

metrics.name: Release Frequency
metrics.explanation: 17 final releases were published in the last 12 months, about one every 21 days, counted from the GitHub releases. The latest final release is from 2026-11-04. Drafts and pre-releases are left out.
